def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    border=2
    colors=set(cnt)-{bg,border}
    shape=colors.pop()
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==shape]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    brow=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==border for c in range(W))]
    bcol=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==border for r in range(H))]
    if bcol:
        bc=bcol[0]
        d=1 if bc>max(c for _,c in cells) else -1
        far=min(c for _,c in cells) if d==-1 else max(c for _,c in cells)
        gap=(bc-1-far) if d==1 else (far-(bc+1))
        line=(far+gap*d)-d   # far edge after shift, one cell beyond (away from border)
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d*gap]=shape
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=8
    else:
        bb=brow[0]
        d=1 if bb>max(r for r,_ in cells) else -1
        far=min(r for r,_ in cells) if d==-1 else max(r for r,_ in cells)
        gap=(bb-1-far) if d==1 else (far-(bb+1))
        line=(far+gap*d)-d
        for r,c in cells: out[r+d*gap][c]=shape
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=8
    for r in brow:
        for c in range(W): out[r][c]=border
    for c in bcol:
        for r in range(H): out[r][c]=border
    return out
